kashika: सुनोतेर्यजतेश्च ङ्वनिप् प्रत्ययो भवति। सुत्वा॥ यज्वा॥
kashikaEnglish: ङ्वनिप् after सु/यज् (past): सुत्वा 'soma-presser', यज्वा 'sacrificer'. त् augment by 6.1.71.
englishFull:
सुयजोर्ङ्वनिप् — "After सु 'to extract juice' and यज् 'to sacrifice', ङ्वनिप् is used with past meaning."

| Root | Form | Meaning |
|------|------|---------|
| सु | सुत्वा | one who has extracted juice |
| यज् | यज्वा | one who has sacrificed |

**Derivation:** सु + ङ्वनिप् → सुत् + वन् (by @ref[6.1.71]) → सुत्वन्
